extracted.name: 🍴 CHABAB 🍴
extracted.description: An Emerati pancake my son loves in the morning with honey, cheese or choco syrup.. The texture is like "puto calasiaio", my uncle used to take as "pasalubong" to us from Pangasinan province..
instruction_lines: Combine all dry ingredients. Add all remaining ingredients.. mix well
Let sit for 1 hour then mix..
Heat a frying pan, scope like 50 ml of mixture on heated pan.. until golden brown.. serve with favorite syrup...
